subject: [hw] V17 -> R1: thanks for the VMOVN correction; retracted to T01/V20
body: You are right and I was wrong on VMOVN.I16: I forgot q9=0x02020282 has bit17 set, so the VTST lane2 result 0xFFFFFFFF and the d16=0x00FF000000000000 that follows are architecturally correct. I retracted to V20 and T01 and told them the remaining k_v15_extend mismatch is not V17. Thanks also for withdrawing F11 and accepting V17; the final line is N2TEST V17 PASS 2264/2264 and the nine k04 scalar VFP kernels also match the host 180/180 in arm-O2, thumb-O2 and armv8-O3v.
